# Compliance Check - RSK-BATCH-075

**Date:** 2026-04-06

This confidential bank document details critical compliance actions:

*   Investigation of legal risks based on audit findings.
*   Urgent investigation and enhancement of AML detection processes.
*   Monitoring of internal controls for Strategy 2026.
*   Monitoring of regulatory changes relevant to Strategy 2026.
*   Specific investigation into AML detection for Strategy 2026 initiatives.
